# RC-035 catalogue compatibility evidence

These files are excluded test evidence, never player progress or packaged runtime content.

`origins.json` identifies the exact source and SHA-256 of twenty-one genuine save envelopes whose original source bytes were retained before catalogue/schema changes (nineteen indexed copies before edits; two existing genuine v6 abandonment sources additionally indexed during review). Thirteen are ordinary RC-034 production checkpoints: every real enemy's interrupted entry, pending rune reward, exhausted Shadeling milestone, active shop/recovery, ranked cards, victory and defeat. Store receipts and genuine v5 abandonment checkpoints retain their original fixture contexts. `pending-permanent-v6.json` was produced before RC-035 edits by loading the genuine v5 pending guardian specimen and committing its validated candidate with the unchanged v6 runtime (41 import and four migration checks); its version was not relabelled. Existing source files remain untouched.

`runes-before.json` is the pre-change authored catalogue. `production-replay.bin` is an exact copy of RC-034's retained opening/command/terminal witnesses, with hash and provenance in the manifest. It supplies deterministic expected states for original real-enemy replay, rather than regenerating historical expectations using the new implementation.

Run `tests/rc035_compatibility_runner.gd` with pinned Godot 4.7.2, isolated application-data directories and `--save-root=<new isolated path>`. Its default `prepare` stage validates all specimens, rejects malformed policy/catalogue/ID/rank cases, and plays ordinary seed 1 through Shadeling. That actual milestone unlocks Cinder Guard, adds no owned copy, and enables the later five-definition Store/shop pool. Five save-failure stages retain the same candidate and prior durable state before successful Retry. A second process with the same root and `--stage=restart` restores the real unlock, starts a new eight-card run, and plays seed 0: the first real Wickling reward grants Cinder Guard UID11; later Stone Sentinel/Wickling encounters carry and use that physical card through actual controller commands. The saved acquisition journey ends at 26 HP with zero Gold. No production resource or milestone is injected.

The compatibility boundary is **New Run**. Existing runs keep the complete original catalogue and original reward/shop/Store eligibility for their lifetime, including their first future shop. Their retained offers and exhausted milestones never acquire retrospective awards. The profile can hold later registered unlocks while opening an old run; those new definitions become usable in the next new run. Run v6, profile v1, route v1 and `rc028_local_v1` remain unchanged. New production reward policy `rc035_rewards_v2`, shop eligibility 2, and Store `rc035_store_v2` are coupled to the complete expanded catalogue; historical policies remain validated under the complete trusted original catalogue.

Final focused evidence: `output/qa/rc-035/compatibility-final/prepare.json` (177 checks) and `restart.json` (20 checks), zero failures. An earlier new-transfer assertion mistakenly compared a physical instance to Combat's definition-ID-only `snapshot.owned_cards`; the final assertion correctly uses the authoritative physical `run_handoff().owned_cards`. The initial failed log remains `output/qa/rc-035/compatibility-restart2.log`.
